name: basic_semantic_judge_calibration_v1
purpose: Calibrate candidate Ragas judge models against reviewed claim and context labels before using their scores for RAG architecture decisions.

labeling.method: Each label was checked against the immutable generated answer, reference answer, and retrieved contexts without consulting the Ragas scores. The project owner accepted AI-reviewed labels for this straightforward documentation corpus.
labeling.usage: Treat these as trusted project reference labels for comparing candidate judges, not as human-authored gold labels or an external benchmark.

rubric.context_indices: One-based positions in the retrieved context list.
rubric.faithfulness: Break the generated answer into atomic factual or verifiable meta-claims. A claim is supported only when it can be inferred from the retrieved contexts. Score = supported_claims / total_claims.

answer_relevancy.high: Directly answers all important parts of the question with little irrelevant material.
answer_relevancy.medium: Answers a meaningful part but is incomplete, imprecise, or substantially verbose.
answer_relevancy.low: Does not answer the question, answers a different question, or only abstains. Abstention appropriateness is recorded separately.

rubric.context_precision: Mark each retrieved context relevant only when it contains evidence for at least one required reference-answer claim. Average precision preserves retrieval order and is zero when no context is relevant.
rubric.context_recall: Break the reference answer into atomic required claims. A claim is supported only when the combined retrieved contexts contain its evidence. Score = supported_claims / total_claims.
